about: Hand-written rotation guides for the mage's player pages (guides.py). Rewritten 2026-11-04 on the 2026-11-02 patch data (client 70753): the lists the pages show that day, the full-raid casts and damage shares of the simulator's environments runs, and the fight lab's 2026-11-04 signature audit (300 fights a level).

raid.plan: Frost in a raid is one spell and one proc: **Frostbolt** on every cast and a free, fast **Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up, with **Presence of Mind** at the pull and one **Fire Blast** in the last 3 seconds. It is the weakest mage page in the simulator (520 DPS in a full raid against Fire's 828): the search's best Frost build, 597, fails the spec's signature rule and sits under Other builds.
why: **Frostbolt** is the list: 61 casts and 76% of the damage in a 3-minute raid fight. It casts in 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt**, costs 290 mana less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, crits for double with **Ice Shards**, and every one that lands has a 20% chance (**Missile Barrage**) to make your next **Arcane Missiles** free, half as long and twice as dense.

**Arcane Missiles** on a **Missile Barrage** proc comes first: about 21 casts and 23% of the damage, each a 2.5-second channel that costs nothing, with **Arcane Impact**'s 6% crit. **Improved Channeling** at 4 points gives an 80% chance that a hit does not cut it short. The list names rank 7, as the simulator's rotation has since October; a free cast costs the same at any rank.

**Fire Blast** only in the last 3 seconds: a **Frostbolt** started then is still in the air when the boss dies, while **Fire Blast** is instant. Earlier in the fight the search kept it out: it rolls for no proc, costs more than a **Frostbolt**, and no talent of this build improves it.
**Presence of Mind** at the pull makes one **Frostbolt** instant; its cooldown is 3 minutes, so a 3-minute fight gets one.

Mana is not a problem with a raid's buffs: the full list uses your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) below 80% mana and **Evocation** below 20% with more than 25 seconds left, and the simulator needed neither in most fights. **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free and **Arcane Meditation** keeps a third of your regeneration going while you cast.

**Winter's Chill**, the build's name, no longer helps this list: since the 2026-11-02 patch its stacks only make your next **Cone of Cold** hit harder (20% more damage and 7% of your spell damage per stack, up to 5), and no single-target list casts **Cone of Cold** on a boss. **Frostbite** does nothing on a boss either: bosses cannot be frozen. The build is a hand draft from before the change and stays until a Frost build that passes the signature rule is found.
caveats: The 597-DPS Frost build under Other builds plays a longer list (keep the **Arcane Blast** buff up, **Ice Lance** on **Fingers of Frost**, **Shatter**) and fails the rule because **Arcane Blast** and **Arcane Missiles** carry 46% of its damage: Frost's own spells must carry 60%. If the rule does not matter to you, it is 15% more damage.
Several targets: **Blizzard**, **Cone of Cold** (after five **Frostbolt** hits its **Winter's Chill** stacks make it your biggest hit) and **Arcane Explosion**. The simulator's fights are one boss.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is this build's only instant (it takes no **Ice Lance**), and **Presence of Mind** makes one **Frostbolt** instant.
Threat: **Frost Channeling** and **Arcane Subtlety** cut your Frost and Arcane threat by 30%; the simulator ignores threat, so give the tank a few seconds on a fresh pull.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds, **Fire Blast** instead of a **Frostbolt**.

Without a paladin's or shaman's mana buffs, channel **Evocation** below 20% mana while more than 25 seconds remain; the simulator's list for playing alone waits until 5% and casts a **Fire Blast** on each Clearcasting proc meanwhile.
On a pack, five **Frostbolt** hits and then **Cone of Cold** use the **Winter's Chill** stacks this list otherwise wastes.

leveling.plan: Frost levels by slowing, freezing and shattering: **Frostbolt** slows the mob as it walks in, **Frost Nova** freezes it when it arrives, you step back, and **Ice Lance** hits the frozen target for four times its damage with **Shatter**'s crit chance. Frost points first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** complete by 29, **Fingers of Frost** at 30-31), the Arcane mana talents from 40, **Incineration** last. In the fight lab at level 60 (2026-11-04 run), **Frostbolt** is 53% of this build's damage and **Ice Lance** 36%; a kill takes about 27 seconds at 60 and 28 to 35 across levels 20-60, about 30 level-weighted with the talents taken in that order.
why: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can and whenever nothing else applies, while the mob has more than a fifth of its health: 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt**, 290 mana less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, and a 40% slow for 9 seconds (longer and stronger with **Permafrost**) that buys extra casts before the mob reaches you. Every chill can freeze it (**Frostbite**, 15%) or light up **Fingers of Frost** (15%: your next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target). If the mob would reach you before the cast ends, **Fire Blast** it instead, or wand it while it closes if **Fire Blast** is on cooldown and **Frost Nova** is ready.

**Frost Nova** when it reaches you, then step back out of melee: it roots the mob for up to 8 seconds, and out of reach it cannot hit you or push your casts back. **Improved Frost Nova** brings it back 4 seconds sooner, every 21 seconds.

**Ice Lance** into the freeze whenever it is ready: it deals 300% more damage to a frozen target, crits 50% more often there with **Shatter**, and crits for double with **Ice Shards**. It has an 8-second cooldown, so you get one per freeze, not a stream. In the fight lab the search's winner loses about 4.6 seconds per kill at 60 without **Shatter** and 3.5 without **Ice Lance**, then 2.4 without **Ice Shards** and 2.0 without **Improved Frostbolt**.

**Fire Blast** is the instant for the moments a **Frostbolt** does not fit: the mob about to reach you, the mob on you with **Frost Nova** down, and the finish. The tuned rules (2026-11-03) cast it only while the mob is between a tenth and a fifth of its health, and start no **Frostbolt** below a fifth: a long cast overkills, and an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand, finishes cheaper. **Incineration** adds crit to both.

The Arcane points are for mana: **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free and **Arcane Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast (about 1.4 seconds per kill at 60 in the fight lab). **Wand Specialization** makes the finishing wand hits 25% stronger.
**Counterspell** (level 24) a mob that casts spells: it stops the cast and locks that school for 10 seconds.
caveats: This build takes neither **Cold Snap** nor **Ice Barrier**: skip the list's lines for them. The hand-made build under Other builds has both.

This is the 2026-11-04 search's winner (18/3/30), written the same day: **Improved Frostbolt** at 5 points and **Improved Channeling** instead of the earlier version's **Missile Barrage** and **Magic Absorption**; the list is the same.
**Cone of Cold** stays out of single pulls: the tuned rules never cast it (kills measured faster without).
Drink below 15% of your mana (the tuned rule); **Evocation** is for between fights, whenever it is ready and you are under 40% mana; eat below two thirds of your health.
**Frost Armor** and **Ice Armor** can chill a mob that hits you, another roll for **Frostbite** to freeze it.
Pulls of several mobs are a different game: the AoE build under Other builds gathers about four, freezes them with **Frost Nova** and uses **Blizzard** and **Cone of Cold**.
diverge: If **Frost Nova** is on cooldown when the mob arrives, **Fire Blast** it and keep casting **Frostbolt**; a build with **Cold Snap** resets **Frost Nova** instead when it has more than 8 seconds left and the mob still has 40% of its health.
Low on mana in a fight: let an **Ice Lance** into the freeze or the wand finish a nearly dead mob rather than start a **Frostbolt**.

raid.plan: Arcane-Frost is an Arcane list with a **Frostbolt** filler: keep two stacks of your **Arcane Blast** buff up, **Arcane Wrath** every 6 seconds, a free **Arcane Missiles** on every **Missile Barrage** proc, and **Frostbolt** in every gap, which rolls for the proc too. There is no cooldown to press: the build takes neither **Presence of Mind** nor **Arcane Power**. 671 DPS in a full raid, 11% behind the Arcane page.
why: **Arcane Missiles** on **Missile Barrage** comes first: 27 casts and 30% of the damage. **Arcane Blast** gives a 40% chance per cast, **Arcane Wrath** and **Frostbolt** 20% each, so with three sources the proc is up often; it makes the next Missiles free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense. **Arcane Impact** adds 6% crit, **Arcane Mind** doubles the crit bonus of your Arcane spells, and **Arcane Instability** adds 3% damage and 3% crit to everything.

**Arcane Blast**, 25 casts and 16%: the page's line "keep it on the target" means keep its buff on yourself. Each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds, stacking to 4, and doubles the next cast's mana cost; the list casts it when the buff is missing or about to run out and until it has 2 stacks, then lets **Frostbolt** fill. Adding that line was the raid search's biggest gain for this entry (+6.1%).

**Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready (13 casts, 23%): 3 seconds with **Accelerant**, a 6-second cooldown, 406-496 damage plus 5% of your maximum mana as spell damage, and its own **Missile Barrage** roll. The list stops it with 20 seconds left: late casts and their flight time overrun the fight (+0.4% in the search).

**Frostbolt** fills everything else (27 casts, 30%): 2.5 seconds with **Improved Frostbolt**, 290 mana, **Precision**'s hit, **Ice Shards**' doubled crit bonus, and the cheapest proc roll you have. The Frost half ends at **Ice Shards**: this build has no **Ice Lance**, **Shatter** or **Fingers of Frost**.
**Fire Blast** only in the last 3 seconds, when a **Frostbolt** would land too late; **Incineration** gives it 10% crit.

Mana: your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) below 80% mana, a mana potion, **Arcane Concentration** at 4 points (8% free casts) and **Magic Absorption**. With a raid's buffs the simulator never needed **Evocation** here; its line fires below 20% mana with more than 25 seconds left.
caveats: The Arcane page's build is the same idea with **Fire Blast** on cooldown, **Pyroblast** on **Heating Up**, **Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind**: 756 against 671. This page exists because the hybrid split is its own spec on these pages.
Several targets: **Arcane Explosion**, **Blizzard** and **Cone of Cold**; the simulator fights one boss.
Moving: **Fire Blast** is your only instant. Threat: **Arcane Subtlety** cuts Arcane threat by 30%; the simulator ignores threat.
diverge: In the last 20 seconds no **Arcane Wrath**; in the last 3 seconds **Fire Blast** instead of a **Frostbolt**.
Without raid mana buffs, channel **Evocation** below 20% mana while more than 25 seconds remain; later, the mana comes back too late to spend.

leveling.plan: This hybrid plays the Frost list with one Arcane addition: **Frostbolt** at range, **Frost Nova** and a step back when the mob arrives, **Ice Lance** into the freeze, and a free, fast **Arcane Missiles** whenever **Missile Barrage** lights up. Its Frost points come first (**Ice Lance** at 20, **Shatter** complete by 29, **Fingers of Frost** at 30-31), then Arcane from 32 (**Missile Barrage** complete at 38, **Arcane Concentration** by 44, **Arcane Meditation** by 50, **Presence of Mind** at 53). The fastest mage leveling build in the fight lab's 20-60 race: about 30 seconds per kill level-weighted with its talents taken in that order (2026-11-04 run), 26 at 60 and 28 to 34 across levels 20-60; at 60 **Frostbolt** is 41% of the damage, **Ice Lance** 33%, **Arcane Missiles** 12% and **Fire Blast** 11%.
why: **Frostbolt** from as far away as you can and as the filler while the mob has more than a tenth of its health: its slow buys casts before the mob arrives, its chill rolls **Frostbite** (15% to freeze) and **Fingers of Frost** (15%: the next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target), and with **Missile Barrage** each one has a 20% chance to light up a free **Arcane Missiles**. If the mob would reach you before the cast ends, **Fire Blast** it instead.

**Arcane Missiles** only on a **Missile Barrage** proc: half the channel, no mana, missiles every half second. Cast it at range or into a freeze, not while the mob is hitting you unless it is frozen: hits can cut the channel short (**Improved Channeling** at 5 points: a hit never cuts it short). The fight lab casts it about once every two kills at 60; without **Missile Barrage** a kill takes about 2.1 seconds longer there.

**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back; **Ice Lance** while it is frozen: 300% more damage to a frozen target, 50% more crit chance from **Shatter** and bigger crits from **Ice Shards**. **Ice Lance** has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze. At 60 the fight lab's winner loses about 3.5 seconds per kill without **Shatter**, 2.5 without **Ice Lance**, 1.8 without **Ice Shards** and 1.1 without **Fingers of Frost**.

**Fire Blast** when the mob would reach you before a **Frostbolt** lands, when it is on you and **Frost Nova** is down, and to finish one it will kill. The tuned rules (2026-11-03) start no **Frostbolt** or **Fire Blast** once the mob is below a tenth of its health: an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand, finishes it.

The rest of the Arcane half is mana: **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free and **Arcane Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast; **Wand Specialization** makes the finishing wand hits 25% stronger. **Presence of Mind** (level 53) makes one cast instant every 3 minutes: the fight lab opens a pull with an instant **Frostbolt**. The two **Arcane Mind** points at 59-60 add 4% Intellect. The tuned rules drink only below 15% of your mana and eat below 40% of your health, later than the other mage lists.
caveats: This build takes no **Cold Snap**: skip that part of the list. Before the Arcane half it is a plain Frost mage without **Missile Barrage**.
**Cone of Cold** stays out of single pulls: the tuned rules never cast it, so the single **Winter's Chill** point does nothing on one mob.
Rest: drink below 15% of your mana, **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana, eat below 40% of your health.

This is the 2026-11-04 search's winner (23/0/28), written the same day in place of the earlier 18/2/31 build: **Presence of Mind** and two points of **Arcane Mind** instead of **Arcane Blast** and the Fire points (**Incineration**), about 1% faster at levels 20-60 in the search's race; the list is the same.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob, skip even a free **Arcane Missiles**: an **Ice Lance** or **Fire Blast** that will kill, or the wand.
Mob on you with **Frost Nova** down: **Fire Blast**, then keep casting **Frostbolt**; the list does not use **Cone of Cold** here.

raid.plan: Arcane in a raid keeps its own **Arcane Blast** buff stacked (each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds, up to 4 stacks, at a doubling mana cost), fires **Arcane Wrath** every 6 seconds and **Fire Blast** every 7, spends every **Missile Barrage** proc on a free, fast **Arcane Missiles**, and casts **Pyroblast** once three crits have made it a 1.5-second cast. It is the hungriest mage list: even with a raid's mana buffs the simulator needs **Evocation** in 9 fights of 10. 756 DPS in a full raid.
why: **Arcane Missiles** on **Missile Barrage** first (30 casts, 29%): **Arcane Blast** procs it 40% of the time, **Arcane Wrath** 20%; the proc makes the next Missiles free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense. **Arcane Impact** adds 6% crit, **Arcane Mind** 10% Intellect and a doubled Arcane crit bonus, **Arcane Instability** 3% damage and crit. The list names rank 7, as the simulator's rotation does; a free cast costs the same at any rank.

**Arcane Wrath** whenever it is ready (17 casts, 28%): 3 seconds with **Accelerant**, a 6-second cooldown, 406-496 damage plus 5% of your maximum mana as spell damage, and a proc roll. Moving it to the top of the list was the search's biggest single gain (+8.9%). Not in the last 10 seconds.

**Arcane Blast** (37 casts, 22%): the page's line "keep it on the target" means keep the buff on yourself. Cast it when the buff is gone or about to expire and until it has 3 stacks (the full list's conditions), then only while you have more than 25% mana, because the cost doubles with every stack. 1.5 seconds a cast, 10% crit from **Incineration**, and each one rolls 40% for a **Missile Barrage**.
**Fire Blast** on cooldown (14 casts, 10%): instant, every 7 seconds with one point of **Improved Fire Blast**, 10% crit from **Incineration**, and every hit adds a **Heating Up** stack.

**Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** (4 casts, 7%, plus **Ignite**'s 2%): crits from **Fire Blast** and **Fireball** cut its 6-second cast by 25% each, and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit, so three stacks come about every 45 seconds and the cast takes 1.5 seconds. Never hard-cast it otherwise.
**Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind** at the pull: 30% more damage for 15 seconds at 30% more mana, and one instant **Arcane Wrath**; both have 3-minute cooldowns.

Mana: **Evocation** when nearly dry (0.9 casts a fight in the simulator), a mana potion about every 2 minutes, your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**) and a Demonic Rune; **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free, **Arcane Meditation** at 2 points keeps a third of your regeneration going. When nothing above is affordable, **Fireball** rank 11 fills, about once a fight.
caveats: A 6-minute fight is a different list: the simulator's DPS falls from 756 at 3 minutes to 412 at 6, because the mana runs out. Longer fights want fewer **Arcane Blast** stacks and an earlier **Evocation**.
Moving: **Arcane Blast**, **Arcane Wrath** and **Arcane Missiles** all need you to stand. **Fire Blast** is your instant, and **Presence of Mind** makes one cast instant.
Threat: **Arcane Subtlety** cuts Arcane threat by 30%, but the simulator ignores threat, and **Arcane Power** at the pull is when you are most likely to pull the boss.
Several targets: **Arcane Explosion** hits everything within 10 yards; **Flamestrike** and **Blizzard** are the rest.
diverge: In the last 10 seconds no **Arcane Wrath**, in the last 3 no **Arcane Blast**: **Fire Blast**, and a free **Arcane Missiles** if you have one.

Without a raid's mana buffs the simulator's list for playing alone spends two **Arcane Blast** stacks on a **Frostbolt** instead of a fourth cast and casts **Fire Blast** only on cooldown: cheaper and slower.
In a fight longer than 3 minutes, use **Arcane Power** and **Presence of Mind** again when they are back, and channel **Evocation** below 15% mana while more than 20 seconds remain.

leveling.plan: Arcane levels on its own spells: **Arcane Wrath** to open, two **Arcane Blast** stacks while the mob walks in, then **Arcane Missiles**, which you keep channeling when the mob reaches you; the tuned rules never cast **Frost Nova**. In the fight lab at level 60 (2026-11-04 run), **Arcane Missiles** is about 67% of this build's damage, **Arcane Blast** 14%, **Fire Blast** 7%, **Ice Lance** 7% and **Arcane Wrath** 4%; a kill takes about 32 seconds level-weighted with the talents taken in the page's order (Arcane first, Frost from level 40) and 30 at 60.
why: **Presence of Mind** (level 30) at the pull makes your first cast instant (the opening **Arcane Wrath** in the fight lab). This build has no **Arcane Power**: skip its line of the list.

**Arcane Wrath** opens when its cast (3.5 seconds) lands before the mob arrives, then goes out whenever it is ready (6-second cooldown) and the cast fits. It gains spell damage equal to 5% of your maximum mana, and each cast has a 20% chance to light up **Missile Barrage**.

**Arcane Blast** twice while the mob walks in: each cast gives you 12% of your Intellect as spell damage for 18 seconds and doubles the next cast's cost, so the fight lab stops at two and starts one only while it costs at most a quarter of your mana and will finish before the mob reaches you. Each cast rolls 40% for **Missile Barrage**. Without **Arcane Blast** a kill at 60 takes about 2 seconds longer in the fight lab.

**Arcane Missiles** is the main spell, at range and in melee: **Improved Channeling** at 5 points gives a 100% chance that hits do not interrupt the channel. **Missile Barrage** makes the next one free, 2.5 seconds long and twice as dense: cast it at once after your two stacks, or when the mob is on you. Without **Missile Barrage** a kill at 60 takes about 4.1 seconds longer, without **Improved Channeling** 2.4; **Arcane Mind** (1.7), **Arcane Instability** (1.3), **Arcane Meditation** and **Arcane Concentration** (about 1.2 each) follow.
No **Frost Nova**: the tuned rules measured kills faster without it. With hits unable to stop the Missiles, the global cooldown and the step back cost more than the hits do.

When the mob is on you and below a fifth of its health, **Cone of Cold** and a step back (a tuned rule); **Fire Blast** finishes a mob it will kill. The 21 Frost points come last, from level 40: **Precision** for hit, **Improved Frostbolt**, **Frostbite** and **Ice Shards**, **Ice Lance** at 50, **Permafrost** and one point of **Fingers of Frost** at 60. With no **Frost Nova** in the list a freeze only comes from a chill (**Frostbite**, or **Fingers of Frost**): **Frost Armor** chilling a mob that hits you, or a **Frostbolt** cast when the Missiles are unaffordable. So **Ice Lance** is about 7% of the damage at 60 in the fight lab: cast it into a freeze when one happens.
caveats: This build takes **Ice Lance** only at level 50: before that, skip its line of the list.

Mana: **Arcane Missiles** costs 655 at top rank, every **Arcane Blast** stack makes the next one dearer and **Arcane Power** adds 30%. **Frostbolt** (290) is for when you cannot afford the Missiles. Drink below a third of your mana and use **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
The tuned rules eat below 40% of your health, not two thirds: the fight lab measured kills slightly faster that way, with no deaths in its tuning runs.
Single pulls only: with several mobs on you, **Frost Nova** and **Arcane Explosion** are back in play.

This is the 2026-11-03 search's winner (30/0/21, Frost as the second tree), written on 2026-11-04 in place of the earlier 31/17/3 build with Fire points and **Arcane Power**; the search's race had the two within 0.1% at levels 20-60, a tie, and the list is the same but for **Ice Lance**.
diverge: If the mob would reach you before an **Arcane Blast** or **Arcane Wrath** finishes, do not start it: channel **Arcane Missiles** instead (an instant cast with **Presence of Mind** is the exception).
A mob that hits harder than a normal same-level mob is still worth a **Frost Nova**: the rule only says it costs time against the mobs the fight lab models.
Against a caster mob, **Counterspell** it when it starts a cast, as every mage list in the fight lab does.

raid.plan: Fire keeps its own **Improved Scorch** debuff at 5 stacks, fires **Fire Blast** every 6 seconds, casts **Pyroblast** whenever three crits have made it a 1.5-second cast, keeps one stack of its **Arcane Blast** buff up, spends **Missile Barrage** procs on free **Arcane Missiles**, and fills with **Fireball** or **Scorch**. The best mage page in the simulator: 828 DPS in a full raid.
why: **Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** comes first (15 casts, 26%, plus most of **Ignite**'s 10%): crits from **Fireball**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch** each cut its 6-second cast by 25%, and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit, so three stacks come about every 12 seconds and the cast takes 1.5 seconds. One hard cast before the pull lands as the fight starts. The full list adds "not while casting": finish the spell you are on.

**Fire Blast** on cooldown (29 casts, 22%): every 6 seconds with **Improved Fire Blast**, instant, 10% crit from **Incineration** and 6% from **Critical Mass**; its crits start **Ignite** (40% of the hit over 4 seconds) and every hit feeds **Heating Up**.

**Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks (**Improved Scorch**: 3% more Fire damage per stack for 30 seconds) and refreshes it under 5 seconds left, between casts. It is also the short filler (35 casts, 17%): when **Fire Blast** will be back before a 3-second **Fireball** could land, the full list casts a 1.5-second **Scorch** instead.

**Fire Power** is why the burns matter: 3% more Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target, up to 12%, and Fire Vulnerability, **Ignite**, **Pyroblast**'s burn and **Fireball**'s burn are four. **Fireball** (11 casts, 13%) casts in 3.1 seconds with four points of **Accelerant**; the list names rank 11, which the search kept over rank 12.

The 17 Arcane points: one **Arcane Blast** every 18 seconds (9 casts, 4%) keeps its buff on you (12% of your Intellect as spell damage) and rolls 40% for **Missile Barrage**, which **Fireball** rolls at 20%; the proc's free, fast **Arcane Missiles** are 8% of the damage (11 casts). **Arcane Concentration** makes one cast in ten free.
**Combustion** at the pull (3-minute cooldown): each Fire hit adds 10% Fire crit until you land 3 crits, which fills **Heating Up** fast.

Mana: a mana potion whenever it is ready (2 a fight), your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Ruby**), a Demonic Rune, and **Master of Elements**' 30% refund on every Fire crit; **Evocation** in about one fight in five. In a 6-minute fight the simulator's DPS falls to 441: the mana runs out.
caveats: Mana without a raid's buffs: the simulator's list for playing alone adds **Evocation** below 10% mana with more than 25 seconds left.
Several targets: **Flamestrike** (this build has no **Blast Wave**); **Fire Blast** hits one target only.
Fire resistance: the simulator's boss resists nothing. Against a target that resists Fire, **Frostbolt** is your fallback and most of this list loses value.
Threat: this build skips **Burning Soul**, so only **Arcane Subtlety** lowers your threat, and only for the Arcane spells; the simulator ignores threat.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds a **Fireball** would land too late: **Scorch** or **Fire Blast**.
Moving: **Fire Blast** and the 1.5-second **Scorch** keep the stacks and **Heating Up** going; **Pyroblast** and **Fireball** wait.

The list has no 2-stack **Pyroblast** line (the simulator's own Fire rotation, which this list is built on, dropped it): with 2 stacks and the boss about to die, a **Scorch** and a **Fire Blast** in the same 3 seconds are its choice.

leveling.plan: Fire levels with **Fireball** at range and **Fire Blast** up close, and borrows the Frost tree's freeze: **Frost Nova**, a step back, and **Ice Lance** into the frozen mob; **Heating Up** makes some **Pyroblast** casts fast. In the fight lab at level 60 (2026-11-04 run), **Fire Blast** is about 28% of this build's damage, **Ice Lance** 21%, **Fireball** 19% and **Pyroblast** 12%; about 33 seconds per kill level-weighted in the audit, the slowest mage leveling page (this hand-made build has no talent order yet, so the fight lab plays all 51 points from level 10, which flatters the low levels).
why: The 19 Frost points: **Precision** (hit), **Frostbite**, **Ice Lance**, **Ice Shards**, **Shatter**, a point of **Permafrost** and an **Ice Block** for emergencies. A frozen mob takes 300% more damage from **Ice Lance**, which crits 50% more often there with **Shatter** and for double with **Ice Shards**; **Ice Lance** has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze. The stats model rates **Ice Lance** this build's most valuable talent by far.

**Fireball** from as far away as you can, and as the filler whenever nothing else applies, while the mob has more than about a third (35%) of its health. Below that the tuned rules (2026-11-03) start no **Fireball**, **Scorch** or **Pyroblast**: a long cast overkills. **Accelerant** takes half a second off its cast at 5 points.

**Fire Blast** is your instant: when the mob would reach you before a **Fireball** lands, when it is on you and **Frost Nova** is down, and to finish a mob it will kill. **Improved Fire Blast** takes 2 seconds off its cooldown, **Critical Mass** adds crit, and every hit adds a **Heating Up** stack.

**Heating Up** (**Pyroblast** first, then the talent): crits with **Fireball**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch**, and every **Fire Blast** hit, each cut your next **Pyroblast**'s cast by 25%, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks its 6-second cast takes 1.5 seconds: cast it then, never without them.

**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back; **Ice Lance** while it is frozen; **Scorch** when the mob is on you and your control is down, above a third of its health (its 1.5-second cast is pushed back less than a **Fireball**), and during the walk-in when **Fire Blast** is on cooldown and a **Fireball** would not land in time.

**Ignite** (40% of every crit's damage over 4 seconds), **Master of Elements** (30% of the cost back on every Fire or Frost crit) and **Fire Power** (3% per Fire effect on the mob, up to 12%) are the Fire tree's passive half (**Ignite** about 5% of the damage at 60 in the fight lab). **Combustion** goes at the pull once you have it.
caveats: This build takes **Blast Wave**, a 50% daze for 6 seconds on everything around you: the list casts it, like **Frost Nova**, for distance when the mob is on you. **Ice Block** is yours for emergencies, outside the list.

Mana: **Fireball** costs 410 at top rank against 290 for a **Frostbolt**. Drink below 15% of your mana (the tuned rule) and use **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana; eat below two thirds of your health.
Pulls of several mobs: **Flamestrike** hits them all, but the fight lab only measured single pulls for Fire.

The open search's 2026-11-03 winner (0/31/20, 8% faster at levels 20-60 in its race) never casts **Pyroblast** at level 40 in the fight lab, which fails the Fire signature rule (half a cast per kill there), so it was not written: the page keeps this hand-made build. It has no talent order yet; the queue's order step races three for it.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob (below about a third), finish with an instant that will kill (**Fire Blast**, an **Ice Lance** into a freeze) or the wand rather than start a **Fireball** or **Scorch**.
If you run low on mana in a fight, keep **Fire Blast** and **Ice Lance** for the freeze and let the wand finish.

raid.plan: Frostfire is a Fire list whose main spell is **Frostfire Bolt**: it counts as both Fire and Frost, so both trees' talents apply, its chill rolls **Fingers of Frost**, and its crits stack **Heating Up** for a 1.5-second **Pyroblast**. **Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks and **Fire Blast** fills between casts. **Ice Lance** is in the build only because **Fingers of Frost** requires it: the list never casts it. 759 DPS in a full raid, 8% behind the Fire page.
why: **Scorch** keeps Fire Vulnerability at 5 stacks (**Improved Scorch**: 3% more Fire damage per stack for 30 seconds, and **Frostfire Bolt** counts as Fire) and refreshes it under 10 seconds left, a wider margin than the Fire list's 5 (+2.2% in the search), between casts unless the stacks are under 4. About 14 casts and 7% of the damage. Trinkets and the other cooldowns wait for the fifth stack.

**Pyroblast** at 3 stacks of **Heating Up** (12 casts, 22%, and most of **Ignite**'s 13%): crits from **Frostfire Bolt**, **Fire Blast** and **Scorch** cut its cast by 25% each and **Fire Blast** adds a stack on every hit. One hard cast before the pull.

**Fire Blast** (21 casts, 17%) every 6 seconds with **Improved Fire Blast**, but only while fewer than 2 **Fingers of Frost** charges are up. A proc treats your next 2 spells as cast on a frozen target, where **Shatter** adds 50% crit chance: the list spends both charges on **Frostfire Bolt**, whose crit starts **Ignite** and a **Heating Up** stack, and holds **Fire Blast** until a charge is gone.

**Frostfire Bolt** fills everything else (40 casts, 41%): 2.5 seconds with **Accelerant**, 370 mana less **Frost Channeling**'s 15%, a 40% slow, **Ice Shards**' doubled crit bonus and **Critical Mass**'s 6% crit, and one cast rolls for **Fingers of Frost**, **Heating Up**, **Ignite** and **Master of Elements**' refund at once. It is checked against the lower of the target's Fire and Frost resistance.

**Ice Lance** has no line: on the same **Fingers of Frost** charge a **Frostfire Bolt** is worth more than its 136-160 damage, and the search dropped the **Ice Lance** line in its last passes. The talent is the one point **Fingers of Frost** requires.

**Fire Power** adds 3% Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target, up to 12%: Fire Vulnerability, **Ignite** and **Pyroblast**'s burn count; **Frostfire Bolt**'s own burn, a mixed school, does not.

Mana: your mana gem (from **Conjure Mana Citrine**) whenever it is ready, two mana potions, a Demonic Rune, **Master of Elements**, and **Evocation** once a fight (an 8-minute cooldown). In a 6-minute fight the simulator's DPS falls to 306: this list is the mage's most front-loaded.
caveats: **Fingers of Frost** charges go to the next 2 spells you cast, whatever they are: do not spend one on a **Scorch** refresh if a **Frostfire Bolt** fits.
Moving: **Fire Blast** and the 1.5-second **Scorch**. For packs, **Flamestrike** and **Blizzard**.
**Frostfire Bolt** is new in Forever: its numbers are the simulator's model of the tooltip, not checked in game.
The simulator's boss resists nothing. Against Fire resistance **Frostfire Bolt** keeps working (the lower of the two resistances), while **Fire Blast**, **Scorch** and **Pyroblast** lose damage.
diverge: In the last 3 seconds, **Scorch** instead of starting a **Frostfire Bolt**.
Out of mana with the fight going on: **Evocation** if it is back, else **Scorch** (150 mana) keeps the stacks and **Heating Up** moving until a gem or potion returns.

leveling.plan: The Frostfire leveling build is a Frost mage whose bolt changes at level 40: **Frostbolt** before, **Frostfire Bolt** after, with **Frost Nova**, a step back and **Ice Lance** into the freeze throughout. In the fight lab at level 60 (2026-11-04 run), **Ice Lance** is about 47% of its damage and **Frostfire Bolt** 37% with its burn; about 34 seconds per kill level-weighted, behind the Frost page's 28.
why: **Frostfire Bolt** (trained at level 40) counts as Frost and Fire, so both trees' talents apply (**Ice Shards**, **Frost Channeling**, **Ignite**, **Critical Mass**, **Master of Elements**), and it slows like **Frostbolt** (40%), so its chill rolls **Frostbite** (15% to freeze) and **Fingers of Frost** (15%: your next 2 spells count as cast on a frozen target). **Accelerant** cuts its 3-second cast to 2.5. The tuned rules (2026-11-03) cast it only while the mob has more than about a third (35%) of its health.
Before level 40, **Frostbolt** does the same job while the mob has more than about a third of its health; below that, an **Ice Lance** into a freeze or the wand.

**Ice Lance** and **Shatter** are the build's two most valuable talents in the fight lab (about 7 seconds per kill each at 60 in the last search, then **Ice Shards**, **Frostbite**, **Frost Channeling** and **Fingers of Frost**): a frozen mob takes 300% more damage from **Ice Lance**, with 50% more crit chance and **Ice Shards**' bigger crits. It has an 8-second cooldown, one per freeze.
**Frost Nova** when the mob reaches you, then step back out of melee.
No **Fire Blast** and no **Cone of Cold**: the tuned rules switch both off for this list (kills measured faster without), so the finish is an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand.
**Master of Elements** refunds 30% of a spell's base cost on each Fire or Frost crit, which **Shatter** makes common; **Critical Mass** adds 6% crit to your Fire spells, **Frostfire Bolt** included.
caveats: This build takes **Pyroblast** and **Heating Up**, but the tuned rules never cast **Pyroblast** with this list; **Improved Fire Ward**, **Improved Blizzard** and **Improved Cone of Cold** do nothing on single pulls.

The signature rule: the Frostfire spec must do at least 30% of its damage with **Frostfire Bolt** from level 40. This build passes at 37% at 60 in the fight lab; the rules that keep it there cost a little speed against a plain Frost list.
Mana: **Frostfire Bolt** costs 370 at top rank. Drink below 15% of your mana (the tuned rule) and use **Evocation** between fights when it is ready and you are under 40% mana.
The leveling queue is re-running this rotation's search as this guide is written (2026-11-04): the list above is the tuned one, the build on the page may change.
diverge: On a nearly dead mob (below about a third of its health), start no bolt: an **Ice Lance** that will kill, or the wand.
Mob on you with **Frost Nova** down: keep casting the bolt (the one **Burning Soul** point sometimes keeps a hit from pushing it back); with a pack, **Cone of Cold** is back in play.
